info.title: StockFlow HTTPS API
info.description: Authenticated inventory, sales and account API. Opaque bearer sessions, HTTPS required.

post.description: 10 attempts/IP/minute; 5 failures/account lock login for 15 minutes.

put.description: Send id and unchanged updatedAt from the last GET. Stale versions return 409.

get.description: Inclusive dates, at most 366 days between dates. Dates use the store server's business day.

post.description: UUID D format. Reuse the same key and same basket on retries. Same key with different products/quantities returns 409. Price and cost always come from the server.

put.description: Revokes every session of this user.
Revokes every session of this user. Current admin cannot disable their own account.

bearerSession.description: Opaque session token returned by /api/v1/auth/login (not a JWT).
